method: Read docs/character_plan_20261116.json (facts), docs/class_stats_judgement.md, js/class_stats.js, docs/weather_20261115.md, docs/remaining_heroes_plan_20261115.md, then checked numbers in index.html, js/weather.js, js/ultimate_fx.js. Computed by python arithmetic: hits to kill = average enemy HP 97.5 / damage, the 8x8 hits-to-kill matrix (ceil(target HP / attacker damage)), and a rough Power = HP x (damage + status damage per hit) x hit-window factor, using the judgement file model (Power equal means an even pairing; hit chance proportional to hit window width). Nothing was played or simulated; Power figures are hand estimates with statuses counted at their upper bound (bleed/poison 2 x 2 = 4, burn 2 x 3 = 6, frost multiplier 1.09 at 15 percent) and the knight at 20 per throw (class_stats.js:165, unverified).

roles.skeleton: All-round striker: 24 damage, bleed plus frost, steady 36 ultimate.
roles.wizard: Glass cannon: 85 HP, poison, splash ultimate that hits anything near the landing point.
roles.bat: Tempo controller: low damage 22, but the shuriken stops the target from moving next turn; 5-shuriken ultimate.
roles.knight: Tank with a random die shot and a hidden-block ultimate (partly wired); highest HP 120.
roles.reaper: Slim attrition caster: narrow hit zone, burn (planned), 3-flame volley ultimate.
roles.bride: Precision finisher: wide 105 px wave but stepped falloff, poison, the biggest ultimate (57.5 in 1v1).
roles.hunchback: Bruiser: 110 HP, bleed, 50 px knockback, piercing boomerang ultimate (52.5 in 1v1).
roles.hag: Tempo support: plain cross, no status, ultimate is a stun with only 22 damage.

overlaps.why: Both throw one bleeding projectile at 100/24 and 110/21; hunchback is skeleton with more HP and knockback instead of frost.
Both are damage-over-time single throwers: 100/24 and 105/23, bleed 2 x 2 versus burn 2 x 3 (burn not wired).
Same 22 damage and near HP (90 and 95); the only differences are bat slow and hag stun ultimate.
Both are low-HP poison hitters (85 and 75 HP), both ultimates ignore the shield or hit an area.

gaps: No hero changes trajectory or reach: all share one launch speed (remaining_heroes_plan question 4 chose 1.0), so skill expression is only aim and power.
No terrain or fence play: the fence takes 8 per hit (index.html:464) but no hero attacks it differently.
Almost every hero is a single-target nuker plus a damage-over-time status; the only defensive identity is the knight.
counter_notes: Reaper is hard to hit: index.html:2000 gives it a hit half-width of 50 instead of 70, so enemy hit window 100 px instead of 140 (factor 0.71).
Bride counters reaper: index.html:2000 uses the wave half-width 105 for the wave regardless of the reaper, so the slim body does not protect it from the wave.
Knight beats bride on paper: knight needs 3 hits on 75 HP (ceil(75/30), if the 30 lands) while the bride needs 7 on 120 HP (ceil(120/19.35)); the knight total of 30 is unverified.
Skeleton beats hag: skeleton kills hag in 4 hits (ceil(95/24)), hag kills skeleton in 5 (ceil(100/22)), and the hag has no status to answer the frost.

strengths: Ultimate is three independent javelins, so a partial miss still pays
weaknesses: Damage 24 is the highest of the plain throwers

contradictions_or_doubts.detail: Facts (character_plan_20261116.json:25) say 30 percent; index.html:1144 multiplies by 0.85 (15 percent); js/class_stats.js:272 says 0.15; judgement says 20 percent (line 22); index.html:735 comment still says 30 percent.

Facts line 16 say storm x0.5; js/weather.js:21 and docs/weather_20261115.md say 0.9. At 0.5 the hunchback would need ceil(120 / 10.5) = 12 hits on the knight (over the hard 8), at 0.9 only ceil(120 / 18.9) = 7.

Facts line 85 describe burn 2 x 3 on the normal throw; grep of index.html finds no applyBurn and no burn status (only comments at lines 1962 and 2047); remaining_heroes_plan N4/N5 list it as not built.
Facts line 70 say NOT wired; index.html:679, 1202 and 1989 create the KnightUlt object and stop shots at a hidden block, so it is at least partly in the page (unverified end to end).
Facts line 44 say so, but the bride is 25 and the knight total is 30 versus the wizard 24.
index.html:2000 uses 50 for the reaper and 70 for others; not in the facts or in class_stats.js (hitHalfWidth 70).
bride 75/27 (line 173) vs page 75/25; hunchback 130/20 with a bell (line 183) vs page 110/21 with an axe; no hag row. The sim result for the roster would be wrong until S1 is done.

Facts say 1.5 x normal / 3 with +5 percent per earlier hit and a head crit on the third; js/ultimate_fx.js:73 gives strikeDamage(normal, 3) = 12 each, and the 0.95/1/1.05 at line 159 may be only a scale. Total of 36 versus 37.8 or 41.1 unverified.
